newsitem.title: USA: Hallmark says 1996 net revenues up six percent.
newsitem.headline: Hallmark says 1996 net revenues up six percent.

text.p: Hallmark Cards Inc said on Wednesday that it estimated 1996 consolidated net revenues of $3.6 billion, up six percent from 1995 net revenues.

The company said it will contribute $48.1 million to its Employee Profit Sharing and Ownership Plan. The contribution rate for 1996 will be 10 percent of employees' eligible earnings, up from 8.5 percent in 1995.
Although Hallmark does not announce profits, it did tell employees that they achieved their profit plan and that profits grew at a faster rate than revenues.
Hallmark is a leading publisher of greeting cards and related personal expression products.
